items.title: The Azure Databricks GitHub app will request permission to create and manage pull requests
items.text: In an upcoming change, the Azure Databricks GitHub app will request Read and write access to pull requests, so that tools like Genie Code and Genie ZeroOps can create and manage pull requests for you. Your branch protection rules and required reviews still apply. When this happens, owners of GitHub organizations and accounts that have the app installed will receive an email from GitHub titled "Databricks is requesting updated permissions." This is a legitimate request from Azure Databricks. If you don't accept, nothing changes from today. You can still clone, pull, commit, and push. The only difference is that Genie Code and Genie ZeroOps can't create and manage pull requests for you. See Connect your Git provider to Databricks.

items.title: Manage Lakewatch with the Databricks CLI (Beta)
items.text: You can now manage Lakewatch from the command line with the lakewatch command group in the Databricks CLI. Use it to create and manage datasources, parsers, and detection rules, and to update per-catalog Lakewatch configuration. The command group requires Databricks CLI version 1.25.0 or above, and the parser commands require version 1.27.0 or above. See lakewatch command group.

Sharing between Azure China and either AWS GovCloud or AWS GovCloud DoD is not supported. See Databricks-to-Databricks OpenSharing support matrix for cloud environments.

items.title: Upcoming breaking change: array_contains with a constant empty array will return NULL for a NULL value
items.text: Starting on or after January 15, 2027, with ANSI mode enabled in Databricks Runtime 19 and above, array_contains(arr, value) will return NULL, not false, when arr is a constant empty array and value is NULL. map_contains_key(map, key) with a constant empty map will change the same way. As a result, NOT array_contains(arr, value) will no longer match rows where value is NULL. To keep the previous result, use size(arr) > 0 AND array_contains(arr, value). See array_contains function and map_contains_key function.

items.title: On-premises data gateway November 2026 release
items.text: Sections: General improvements and fixes; Security improvements and updates; Feature updates and new capabilities in OPDG: Gateway Dual Relay; Power BI Desktop compatibility; Next steps. The November 2026 release of the on-premises data gateway (version 3000.342) continues our commitment to secure, reliable and accessible connectivity between on-premises data sources and Microsoft Fabric services. This release focuses on strengthening gateway security, improving performance and reliability, enhancing diagnostics, and updating underlying dependencies to maintain compatibility with the latest Power Query capabilities. This release gateway brings more reliable data transfers, improvements to Oracle DirectQuery and expanded diagnostics in the gateway setup application to make troubleshooting easier.
